faq_items.question: What is the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence about?
faq_items.answer: The Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence aims to explore the intersection of mathematics and AI, providing guidance and insights to advance the field.

faq_items.question: How does V7 give AI agents institutional memory?
faq_items.answer: V7 incorporates institutional memory into AI agents by preserving and utilizing historical data, enabling agents to make informed decisions based on past experiences.
